_**Agent (default)**_

### What I meant by an “AdSlot” on /crew

- An AdSlot is a small React component that creates a specific placeholder where AdSense can render an ad.  
- Auto ads let Google decide where to place ads automatically. An AdSlot is for manual placements when you want control (e.g., a banner at the top of [myfilmjobs.com/crew](https://myfilmjobs.com/crew)).

### Minimal example (manual ad unit)
1) Create an ad unit in AdSense to get its slot ID (a number).  
2) Use a reusable component like this:

```tsx
import { useEffect } from "react";

declare global {
  interface Window {
    adsbygoogle: any[];
  }
}

type AdSlotProps = {
  slot: string;               // e.g. "1234567890" from AdSense
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
};

export function AdSlot({ slot, style }: AdSlotProps) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      (window.adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    } catch {}
  }, []);

  return (
    <ins
      className="adsbygoogle"
      style={{ display: "block", ...style }}
      data-ad-client="ca-pub-9402509441119301"
      data-ad-slot={slot}
      data-ad-format="auto"
      data-full-width-responsive="true"
    />
  );
}
```

3) Place it on the `/crew` page where you want the ad:
```tsx
<AdSlot slot="YOUR_AD_SLOT_ID" style={{ margin: "16px 0" }} />
```

Notes:
- Keep the base AdSense script only once in `index.html` (already done).
- Each AdSlot runs a single push so the ad can fill.
- You can add multiple AdSlots with different `slot` IDs on different parts of the page.

```
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import './AdComponent.scss';

export interface AdConfig {
  id: string;
  type: 'adsense' | 'display' | 'sponsored' | 'banner';
  position: 'header' | 'sidebar' | 'footer' | 'content' | 'inline';
  size: 'banner' | 'medium-rectangle' | 'large-rectangle' | 'leaderboard' | 'skyscraper' | 'wide-skyscraper'
 | 'responsive';

  client?: string; // AdSense client ID
  slot?: string; // AdSense ad slot
  responsive?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

interface AdComponentProps {
  config: AdConfig;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
  onAdLoad?: () =&gt; void;
  onAdError?: (error: any) =&gt; void;
}

const AdComponent: React.FC&lt;AdComponentProps&gt; = ({
  config,
  className = '',
  style = {},
  onAdLoad,
  onAdError
}) =&gt; {
  const adRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);
  const [hasLoaded, setHasLoaded] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    if (config.type === 'adsense' &amp;&amp; window.adsbygoogle &amp;&amp; adRef.current &amp;&amp; !hasLoaded) {
      // Check if this ad element already has ads loaded
      const adElement = adRef.current.querySelector('ins.adsbygoogle');
      if (adElement &amp;&amp; !adElement.hasAttribute('data-ad-status')) {
        try {
          (window.adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
          setHasLoaded(true);
          onAdLoad?.();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('AdSense error:', error);
          onAdError?.(error);
        }
      }
    }
  }, [config.id, onAdLoad, onAdError, hasLoaded]);

  const getAdSize = () =&gt; {
    switch (config.size) {
      case 'banner':
        return { width: 728, height: 90 };
      case 'medium-rectangle':
        return { width: 300, height: 250 };
      case 'large-rectangle':
        return { width: 336, height: 280 };
      case 'leaderboard':
        return { width: 728, height: 90 };
      case 'skyscraper':
        return { width: 160, height: 600 };
      case 'wide-skyscraper':
        return { width: 160, height: 600 }; // Same as skyscraper but with different name
      case 'responsive':
        return { width: 'auto', height: 'auto' };
      default:
        return { width: 300, height: 250 };
    }
  };

  const renderAdSense = () =&gt; {
    const { width, height } = getAdSize();
    
    return (
      &lt;ins
        className="adsbygoogle"
        style={{
          display: 'block',
          width: typeof width === 'number' ? &#96;${width}px&#96; : width,
          height: typeof height === 'number' ? &#96;${height}px&#96; : height,
        }}
        data-ad-client={config.client}
        data-ad-slot={config.slot}
        data-ad-format="auto"
        data-full-width-responsive={config.responsive ? "true" : "false"}
      /&gt;
    );
  };

  const renderPlaceholderAd = () =&gt; {
    const { width, height } = getAdSize();
    return (
      &lt;div 
        className="ad-placeholder"
        style={{
          width: typeof width === 'number' ? &#96;${width}px&#96; : width,
          height: typeof height === 'number' ? &#96;${height}px&#96; : height,
          backgroundColor: '#f0f0f0',
          border: '2px dashed #ccc',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          color: '#666',
          fontSize: '14px',
          textAlign: 'center',
          padding: '10px'
        }}
      &gt;
        &lt;div&gt;
          &lt;div style={{ fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: '5px' }}&gt;Ad Space&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div style={{ fontSize: '12px' }}&gt;{config.id}&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div style={{ fontSize: '10px', marginTop: '5px' }}&gt;{typeof width === 'number' ? width : 'auto'} ×
 {typeof height === 'number' ? height : 'auto'}&lt;/div&gt;

        &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    );
  };

  const renderDisplayAd = () =&gt; {
    return (
      &lt;div className="ad-display"&gt;
        &lt;div className="ad-label"&gt;Advertisement&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;div className="ad-content"&gt;
          {/* Placeholder for display ads */}
          &lt;div className="ad-placeholder"&gt;
            &lt;div className="ad-placeholder-text"&gt;Ad Space&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    );
  };

  const renderSponsoredContent = () =&gt; {
    return (
      &lt;div className="ad-sponsored"&gt;
        &lt;div className="sponsored-label"&gt;Sponsored&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;div className="sponsored-content"&gt;
          {/* Placeholder for sponsored content */}
          &lt;div className="sponsored-placeholder"&gt;
            &lt;div className="sponsored-placeholder-text"&gt;Sponsored Content&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    );
  };

  const renderAd = () =&gt; {
    switch (config.type) {
      case 'adsense':
        // Show placeholder if AdSense is not available or in development
        if (!window.adsbygoogle || process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
          return renderPlaceholderAd();
        }
        return renderAdSense();
      case 'display':
        return renderDisplayAd();
      case 'sponsored':
        return renderSponsoredContent();
      default:
        return renderDisplayAd();
    }
  };

  return (
    &lt;div
      ref={adRef}
      className={&#96;ad-component ad-${config.position} ${className}&#96;}
      style={style}
      data-ad-id={config.id}
      key={&#96;ad-${config.id}-${config.type}&#96;}
    &gt;
      {renderAd()}
    &lt;/div&gt;
  );
};

export default AdComponent; %

```

```
# Ad Monetization System Setup Guide

This guide will help you set up Google AdSense and other monetization features for your website.

## Overview

The ad monetization system includes:
- Google AdSense integration
- Ad placement management
- Revenue tracking and analytics
- Performance monitoring
- Fallback display ads

## Prerequisites

1. **Google AdSense Account**: You need a Google AdSense account approved by Google
2. **Domain Verification**: Your domain must be verified with Google AdSense
3. **Content Compliance**: Ensure your content complies with AdSense policies

## Setup Instructions

### 1. Google AdSense Setup

#### Step 1: Create AdSense Account
1. Go to [Google AdSense](https://www.google.com/adsense)
2. Sign in with your Google account
3. Click "Get Started"
4. Fill in your website details
5. Wait for Google's approval (can take 1-2 weeks)

#### Step 2: Get Your AdSense Code
1. Once approved, go to your AdSense dashboard
2. Navigate to "Sites" → "Ad units"
3. Create new ad units for different placements:
   - Header banner (728x90)
   - Sidebar rectangle (300x250)
   - Content inline (responsive)
   - Footer banner (728x90)

#### Step 3: Update Configuration
1. Open &#96;src/services/ads/adConfig.ts&#96;
2. Replace the placeholder client ID:
   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
   export const ADSENSE_CONFIG = {
     client: 'ca-pub-YOUR_ACTUAL_CLIENT_ID', // Replace with your real client ID
     enabled: process.env.REACT_APP_ADSENSE_ENABLED === 'true',
     testMode: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development',
   };
   &#96;&#96;&#96;

3. Update ad slot IDs in &#96;DEFAULT_AD_CONFIGS&#96;:
   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
   headerBanner: {
     id: 'header-banner',
     type: 'adsense',
     position: 'header',
     size: 'banner',
     client: ADSENSE_CONFIG.client,
     slot: 'YOUR_HEADER_AD_SLOT_ID', // Replace with your ad slot ID
     responsive: true,
   },
   &#96;&#96;&#96;

### 2. Environment Variables

Create or update your &#96;.env&#96; file:

&#96;&#96;&#96;env
# AdSense Configuration
REACT_APP_ADSENSE_CLIENT_ID=ca-pub-YOUR_ACTUAL_CLIENT_ID
REACT_APP_ADSENSE_ENABLED=true

# Analytics Configuration
REACT_APP_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=true

# Development/Production Settings
NODE_ENV=development
&#96;&#96;&#96;

The Google AdSense script is already included in &#96;public/index.html&#96;. Make sure to update the client ID:

&#96;&#96;&#96;html
&lt;script async src="https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-YOUR_ACTUAL_
CLIENT_ID" crossorigin="anonymous"&gt;&lt;/script&gt;

## Ad Placement Strategy

### Current Ad Placements

1. **Header Banner** (728x90)
   - Position: Top of page
   - Priority: High
   - Visibility: Excellent

2. **Sidebar Rectangle** (300x250)
   - Position: Right sidebar
   - Priority: Medium
   - Visibility: Good

3. **Content Inline** (Responsive)
   - Position: Within content
   - Priority: Medium
   - Visibility: Good

4. **Footer Banner** (728x90)
   - Position: Bottom of page
   - Priority: Low
   - Visibility: Moderate

### Page-Specific Configurations

Different pages have optimized ad placements:

- **Home Page**: Header + Sidebar
- **Projects Page**: Header + Sidebar + Content inline
- **Crew Page**: Header + Sidebar
- **Social Page**: Header + Multiple content inline
- **Analytics Page**: All placements for testing

## Revenue Tracking

### Analytics Features

The system tracks:
- Ad impressions
- Click-through rates (CTR)
- Revenue per placement
- Performance metrics
- User engagement

### Dashboard Access

Visit &#96;/ads&#96; to access the revenue dashboard with:
- Real-time revenue tracking
- Performance analytics
- Placement optimization insights
- Export capabilities

## Testing and Development

### Development Mode

In development mode:
- AdSense is disabled by default
- Display ads show as placeholders
- Analytics are still tracked
- Test data can be added

### Production Deployment

Before deploying to production:
1. Update client ID and slot IDs
2. Set &#96;REACT_APP_ADSENSE_ENABLED=true&#96;
3. Verify domain in AdSense
4. Test ad loading and tracking

## Best Practices

### Ad Placement Guidelines

1. **User Experience First**
   - Don't overwhelm users with ads
   - Maintain content readability
   - Use responsive ad units

2. **Performance Optimization**
   - Load ads asynchronously
   - Implement lazy loading
   - Monitor page load times

3. **Compliance**
   - Follow AdSense policies
   - Respect user privacy
   - Implement proper disclosures

### Revenue Optimization

1. **A/B Testing**
   - Test different ad placements
   - Monitor performance metrics
   - Optimize based on data

2. **Content Strategy**
   - Create high-quality content
   - Target relevant keywords
   - Encourage user engagement

## Troubleshooting

### Common Issues

1. **Ads Not Loading**
   - Check client ID and slot IDs
   - Verify domain approval
   - Check browser console for errors

2. **Low Revenue**
   - Optimize ad placements
   - Improve content quality
   - Increase traffic

3. **Policy Violations**
   - Review AdSense policies
   - Remove prohibited content
   - Contact AdSense support

### Debug Tools

1. **Browser Console**
   - Check for JavaScript errors
   - Monitor network requests
   - Verify ad loading

2. **AdSense Dashboard**
   - Monitor ad performance
   - Check policy compliance
   - Review revenue reports

3. **Analytics Dashboard**
   - Track user engagement
   - Monitor ad interactions
   - Analyze performance trends

## Advanced Features

### Custom Ad Units

To add custom ad units:

1. Create new configuration in &#96;adConfig.ts&#96;
2. Add placement strategy
3. Update page-specific configurations
4. Test thoroughly

### Revenue Optimization

1. **A/B Testing Framework**
   - Test different ad sizes
   - Optimize placement timing
   - Monitor user behavior

2. **Performance Monitoring**
   - Track page load times
   - Monitor ad viewability
   - Analyze user engagement

3. **Content Strategy**
   - Create engaging content
   - Target relevant audiences
   - Optimize for search engines
```

Perfect! Now let me summarize what I've fixed:

## ✅ **Issues Fixed Successfully**

### **1. Header Ad Banner Black Background Issue**
- **Problem**: Header ad had white background and box shadow creating black appearance
- **Solution**: Added transparent background and removed box shadow for header ads
- **Result**: Header ads now have transparent background with subtle dashed border

### **2. Resume Download Modal Not Showing**
- **Problem**: Resume download buttons weren't using the ResumeDownloadButton component with ad popup
- **Solution**: 
  - Updated `ResumeDownloadButton` component to support custom download functions
  - Replaced the PDF download button in the resume builder (`EditCrewProfile.tsx`) with `ResumeDownloadButton`
  - Added ad popup functionality to resume downloads

### **3. Ad System Integration**
- **Added**: Resume download buttons now show ad popup before downloading
- **Enhanced**: ResumeDownloadButton supports both URL downloads and custom download functions
- **Integrated**: Ad popup appears when users try to download their resume PDF

## **What You Should See Now:**

1. **Header Ads**: Transparent background with subtle dashed border (no more black background)
2. **Resume Builder**: When you click "Download PDF" on the resume builder page, you'll see:
   - Ad popup appears first
   - 5-second countdown
   - Then the PDF downloads
3. **Ad Placeholders**: Visible on all pages (header/footer)

## **Testing the Resume Download Modal:**

1. **Visit**: `http://localhost:8080/edit-profile` (resume builder)
2. **Fill out**: Some resume information
3. **Click**: "Download PDF" button
4. **Expected**: Ad popup appears with countdown, then PDF downloads

The ad system is now fully functional with proper styling and the resume download modal working correctly! The header ads should no longer have the black background issue, and resume downloads will show the ad popup as intended.

## ✅ **Styling Issues Fixed**

The styling is now much more elegant and professional! The resume download disclaimer has a beautiful blue gradient that's easy on the eyes, and the ad banners no longer have the ugly black surrounding areas.
